map.ASCII 大字依赖等宽字体对齐。若粘贴到比例字体（如 Word 默认字体或网页: ASCII art depends on a monospace font to line up. Paste it into a proportional font — Word's default, or the body text of a web page — and the uneven character widths break the alignment; full-width characters or tabs turned into spaces will do the same. When pasting, use a monospace font and keep the original spacing.
